newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-Russia 728-day OFZ bond priced 96.80 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Russia 728-day OFZ bond priced 96.80 pct.

text.p: The average price of a Russian 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bond was 96.80 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average price would be in the 96.12-97.24 percent range.
The series 24015 bonds, maturing on July 7, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 97.01 to yield 24.60 percent.
The bond will pay semi-annual interest for 182-day periods, with coupon dates on January 21, 1998; July 22, 1998; January 20, 1999; July 21, 1999.
On July 23 the Finance Ministry raised 5.88 trillion roubles by selling series 21080 GKO discount Treasury bills, taking total proceeds from today's auctions to 8.18 trillion roubles.
It has also repaid 6.45 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 210-day T-bills (series 22064) and paid 237.83 billion roubles in interest on a two-year bond (series 24009) maturing in October 1998.
It also repaid 2.65 trillion roubles of the 24009 bond early on a voluntary basis. A total of 3.15 trillion roubles of the bond was in circulation.
